verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt (HTTP 200), Markdown versions of the docs (docs.md and per-page .md URLs), an OpenAPI spec and a live /.well-known/ai-catalog.json. The llms.txt includes explicit 'How agents should use Vercel' guidance and links to llms-full.txt, a docs graph and a taxonomy. Vercel also ships an agent-executable get-started.md playbook and `vercel agent init` to write AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md guidance, so every element of the story is backed by first-party docs and hands-on probes.
